    Profile

    Klima is a young girl who grew up in the remote countryside of Wratharis and has a strong sensitivity to Alchemia that occurs in the natural world. Ever since a young age she has possessed the ability to manipulate the Alchemia in the atmosphere and the weather. Because she grew up in such a quiet and peaceful place, despite her astonishing powers she has a very carefree and easygoing personality.

    Origin: Wratharis
    Gender: Female
    Height: 151cm
    Weight: 39kg
    Birthday: Mar 12
    Blood Type: Type Ki
    Zodiac: Moon of the Water Guardian
    Likes: Fine rain
    Hobbies: Relaxing
    Illust: RINZO
    CV: 佐土原かおり
